# Craftmine Windows protection and delivery

The Windows SecretStore preserves the existing AES-GCM per-secret payload format. Its 32-byte envelope key is protected with current-user Windows DPAPI, with UI forbidden and no LOCAL_MACHINE flag. A legacy raw key is first encrypted and round-trip verified, then replaced atomically. Existing ciphertext is unchanged. Corrupt/foreign protected keys, missing keys with existing ciphertext, and protector failures yield unavailable status rather than a new key or fallback. Non-Windows storage remains the existing explicitly labelled fallback. The status projection never returns credentials or key bytes.

The product uses appId world.craftmine.desktop, CraftmineWorld profile data and the Craftmine icon. Upstream updates stay disabled. NSIS is per-user, does not launch the client on finish, and retains application data on uninstall. Before installation, a hidden offline guard acquires exclusive handles for bounded PI database/domain files and writes a hash-manifest snapshot. A running database or failure blocks installation before replacing application files. The guard does not alter source data, copy credentials or implement another world restore transaction. User-facing portable restore remains an A-owned domain transaction.

The native backup service is the only chooser/path authority. Renderer input may select a business action and opaque operation/grant id, never filesystem paths or raw archives. Inspect grants expire after ten minutes and bind the full file hash; restore also checks the domain's expected current hash. Archives are at most 32MiB. Export and restore operation ids are idempotent, cancellation does not fabricate a successful receipt, and uncertain transport results can be queried or explicitly retried. The scope is every domain world/library/memory in this profile, not just the selected world. No background model replay follows restore.

Diagnostics are built from allowlisted version/hash/environment/status/numeric metric fields. Raw logs, model configuration, secrets, chat, personal paths and world source are excluded. Startup/frame/model-job samples are bounded; missing samples are not zero-duration measurements. Main-process RSS is labelled separately from total application memory.

Builds require a clean Git checkout and pinned lockfiles. A corresponding source archive, provenance, hash manifest, upstream LGPL license, dependency notice inventory, font licenses and Chinese guide accompany the package. Package verification compares bundled Rust/Agent/source hashes to the manifest. The local installer is unsigned. A successful build does not establish clean-Windows installation, upgrade, uninstall or physical UI acceptance.
